statement: Fresh seed and fresh CREATE delegate bounded participant-release completion to one operation in the existing release client. Seed keeps distinct-cohort control-first ordering, one authorization per cohort, one original pass deadline and first diagnostic observations; fresh CREATE keeps its prerequisites and exact answer identity. Single-attempt control/operator requests and existing-origin background recovery retain their current semantics. The decision-boundary audit checks the completion body and caller correspondence rather than waiving a relocated retry loop.

constraints.statement: Extend participant-release-client.js with a protocol-specific completion operation. Remove the duplicated reply-to-delay policy from seed and fresh CREATE. No generic retry engine, new queue, durable ledger, admission owner, success cache, timer cadence or background continuation.

The original trigger, authorization identity, measured build, partition, caller-owned clock and absolute deadline remain unchanged across attempts. Preserve NOT_LEADER cadence, safe nonnegative reply delay, response identity, seed projections and original clock-read order. Both loops may make their final client call when a completed wait reaches the deadline; only seed preserves the original zero-wait race when its wait-preparation read itself reaches the deadline. No budget renewal or timeout increase.

Keep requestParticipantRelease as one attempt plus at most one redirect. Nested control and operator do not use bounded completion. Existing-origin recovery remains separate. Receiver owners still own consensus, origin, membership, pause/resume and OPEN. Lost replies never cancel committed facts; request failure retains existing recovery and cleanup obligations.

Use the existing caller-census plus checked-owner-body pattern. Only the exact validated loop may be classified as owned; a filename, annotation, function name or hash alone is insufficient. Validate the canonical owner even for selected-file audit. Reject deadline renewal, changed guards, duplicate caller retry and policy, spoofed imports, unvalidated/copy owners and nested control routed through completion. Standalone collection without owner context remains conservative.

Preserve old duplicate-policy evidence and existing seed-release-once-per-partition-cohort seal. Freeze regression witnesses before production repair, run old/repaired bytes on locked lab with retries disabled, retain meaningful semantic negatives and independently review the complete operation plus applicable gates. This is not automatic retained-seed admission or U1/release acceptance.
